title: Dependency contract kernel
description: Objective: model immutable typed dependency contracts, witnesses, stability, horizons, alternatives, and challenge results. Deliverable: focused scheduler dependency modules and property tests. NOT in scope: scheduling, materialization, expansion, or semantic auto-merge. Hard dependencies: Runtime contract registry and Planning graph lifecycle core from M1. Owned paths: packages/scheduler/src/dependencies/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test.
definitionOfDone: Blocking edges require a complete typed contract and exact witness provenance.
MONOTONIC is schema-proven; uncertainty defaults REVOCABLE and invalidation is explicit.
Redundant-edge conclusions remain candidates requiring semantic proof.
taskRails: Graph Beta cannot activate until the proven Foundation runner contracts it consumes are green.
A dependency, readiness, fairness, or semantic claim without daemon-verifiable evidence is UNKNOWN or refused.
Keep tasks file-disjoint where possible; order is a presentation hint, not a fabricated hard dependency.
Keep production modules focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400; explicit paths only and no sibling worktree.

implementationPlan.description: TDD red — src/dependencies/dependency-contract.test.ts. Contract completeness matrix (DoD 1): a blocking edge's DependencyContract must carry EVERY field or be refused with a stable local code — field set per design 203 INCLUDING the binding the prose opens with ('immutable GRAPH-BOUND justification for ONE EXECUTION-BLOCKING EDGE'): producerNodeKey, consumerNodeKey, hard edgeKind (ARTIFACT_CONSUMPTION|STATE_PRECONDITION|SCOPE_SERIALIZATION|POLICY_SEQUENCE), graphBindingDigest (hex64); PRODUCER SIDE AS DISCRIMINATED UNION keyed 1:1 to edgeKind — ARTIFACT_CONSUMPTION -> {artifactOrInterfaceRef, digest}; STATE_PRECONDITION -> {daemonFactRef, digest}; SCOPE_SERIALIZATION -> {scopeCollisionObservationRef, digest} (design 208/444); POLICY_SEQUENCE -> {policyRuleId, policyHash} — arm/kind DISAGREEMENT is its own stable code, not generic incompleteness; consumer criterion/PRECONDITION + contract hash; minimumQualifyingMilestone (scheduler-LOCAL closed enum CANDIDATE_SEALED|RESULT_SEALED|EVIDENCE_SEALED|INTEGRATION_SEALED|REVIEW_QUALIFIED|ACCEPTED — documented as scheduler-local, design leaves it open); typed satisfaction predicate ref; stability; witness IDs/versions/digests; consumptionHorizon; necessity/counterfactual as TYPED shape {failedConsumerCriterionRef, failureKind: MISSING_ARTIFACT|PRECONDITION_FALSE|SCOPE_CONFLICT|POLICY_VIOLATION, truthClass}; alternative ruling ALWAYS PRESENT (closed union NOT_APPLICABLE{reason}|INTERFACE_AVAILABLE{ref,digest}|FIXTURE_AVAILABLE{ref,digest}|RULED_OUT{reason} — design 205/421/464: a ruling, not an optional list); alternateProducers; truth/provenance (LOCAL closed 5-string truth vocabulary OBSERVED|AGENT_REPORTED|DAEMON_VERIFIED|HUMAN_APPROVED|UNKNOWN — string-identical to the repo canonical set, locally defined because scheduler is dependency-free; divergence risk documented); invalidation/recheck facts. MONOTONIC rules (DoD 2): predicate registry entry requires schema ID+version, typed parameter schema, SOURCE-OPERATION CLASS whose semantics guarantee non-regression, and proof rationale (design 382: 'registered schema AND source operation prove the fact cannot regress' — a bare provenMonotonic boolean is self-attestation and fails); witness whose producing operation mismatches the entry's declared source-operation class -> REVOCABLE demotion refused as invalid, not silently accepted; unregistered predicate -> REVOCABLE always; non-blocking edge kinds (RELATED|CONTAINS|CONTEXT|PREFERRED_ORDER) never accept a contract requirement and never participate in readiness (assert refusal both ways); document the projection: 4 hard kinds -> GraphEdgeKind HARD, 4 non-blocking -> ADVISORY. Hostile-input cases via runtime-shape helpers (proxy/accessor/prototype tricks refused). Confirm RED.

implementationPlan.description: TDD red then green — src/dependencies/dependency-witness.ts (+ shim). Witness provenance validation: exact IDs, versions (safe nonneg integers), digests (hex64), truthClass from the local vocabulary; MONOTONIC exemption only via registry source-operation match (from dependency-contract.ts). Consumption-horizon model: TOTAL-ORDER rank over gate types — MATERIALIZATION_SEAL < EXECUTOR_CLAIM < EFFECT_ACTIVATE < STEP_START < CANDIDATE_SEAL < RESULT_SEAL < EVIDENCE_SEAL < INTEGRATION_SEAL < REVIEW_QUALIFICATION < ACCEPTANCE_QUALIFICATION < GOAL_COMPLETION (design 382 boundary list; review split from acceptance — review rounds precede acceptance per 232/239; GOAL_COMPLETION is the max element per 203 'up to and including atomic goal completion'); horizon comparison helpers (isWithinHorizon(gate, horizon)). Invalidation records: a REVOCABLE flip is an explicit typed event {witnessRef, sourceFactVersions, flippedAt gate context, truthClass}; POST-HORIZON RULE (design 203 tail): an invalidation arriving PAST the declared horizon returns a typed no-op/refusal result — history is never retroactively rewritten — with its own stable code. SCOPE FENCE (documented in module header): this module models the invalidation EVENT RECORD only — the 382 cascade (tombstoning, drain dispositions, slot release, DEPENDENCY_INVALIDATED transitions), Blocker lifecycle (234), frontier/readiness (partitionFrontier exists), and PlanningHold lifecycle are OUT of scope. Tests inside dependency-contract.test.ts extend or a focused block in the invariants file — keep the two test files as the complete surface.

implementationPlan.description: TDD red then green — src/dependencies/dependency-analysis.ts (+ shim). DO NOT re-implement structural transitive reduction — packages/scheduler/src/redundancy.ts findRedundancyCandidates + graph-model RedundancyCandidate (exported, requiresSemanticProof: true) ALREADY exist. This module layers CONTRACT-level assessment on top (design 392: core proves 'equivalence/redundancy for typed contracts'): ContractRedundancyAssessment takes an existing structural RedundancyCandidate (imported via relative '../graph-model.js' / '../redundancy.js' — in-package relative imports are legal; NON-COLLIDING type names, a second exported RedundancyCandidate would be a tsc duplicate-export conflict if ever surfaced) + the DependencyContracts along the flagged edge and its alternate hard path, and produces a typed conclusion that remains a CANDIDATE: {kind: "REDUNDANCY_CANDIDATE", structuralCandidate, contractComparison (producer-arm/predicate/horizon equivalence facts), requiresSemanticProof: true (ALWAYS — DoD 3), semanticProofObligation (what a human/daemon must furnish)} — never an edge-removal authorization. DependencyChallenge types (design 419/237/306): statuses LIFECYCLE-DERIVED, not an invented adjudication enum — OPEN | MAPPED_TO_EXISTING_CONTRACT | RESOLVED_BY_SUPERSESSION | CLOSED_NO_CHANGE | SUPERSEDED | DEDUPLICATED{existingChallengeRef}, each carrying the bound successor planning-run REF (opaque string — NO planning-core type import) + version binding; dedup key = contract/edge hash + graph epoch + source-fact versions; BOTH directions modeled: missing-edge discovery (agent path: AGENT_REPORTED, self-hold on the caller's OWN leased node only — foreign-node holds refused, A-on-B + B-on-A mutual holds refused) and existing-edge necessity/redundancy challenge (SEMANTIC_PREREQUISITE must reference an existing current hard contract). Property tests in dependency-kernel-invariants.test.ts (seeded xorshift): uncertainty NEVER yields MONOTONIC across random registry/witness permutations; assessments ALWAYS carry requiresSemanticProof: true; post-horizon invalidations always no-op; outputs deep-frozen + deterministic (same seed -> identical); hostile inputs refused via runtime-shape helpers.
